name: Junlin Gonghe
source:
Kingdom Come is an adult visual novel about a prince who wants to escape his fate, and the mercenary who catches him before he falls.

Alexander Melchizedek is the heir of a nation, a symbol of hope, and a prisoner of his father’s design. On the night of his coming-of-age ceremony, his carefully planned rebellion is interrupted by Archer Magnum—a reckless, charming, and dangerously perceptive mercenary hired to become his personal shield.

But protection is never simple.

Between political schemes, forbidden desire, hidden agendas, and rumors of ancient artifacts, Alexander must decide whether Archer is a weapon he can use, a threat he should fear, or the first person who truly sees the anger beneath his crown.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4815610/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《君临共和》是一部成人视觉小说，讲述一位渴望逃离宿命的王子，与在他坠落之前将他稳稳接住的佣兵之间的故事。

亚历山大·麦基洗德是一国王储、民众希望的象征，却也是困在父王棋局中的囚徒。成年礼当晚，他精心策划的叛逃计划被亚契·麦格农打断——这名鲁莽不羁、魅力十足又洞察力敏锐得危险的佣兵，受雇成为了他的贴身护盾。

然而“保护”从来都不是一件单纯的事。

周旋于政治阴谋、禁忌情欲、暗藏私心与远古神器的传闻之间，亚历山大必须做出抉择：亚契究竟是一件可供他驱策的利器、一个他应当忌惮的威胁，还是世上第一个真正看穿他王冠之下满腔怒火的人。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4815610/]Steam[/url]]
